verdict.rationale: Lambda documents filesystems as a high-capacity regional file store you attach to instances to hold datasets and back up system state, which implies storage that exists independently of any single instance. An S3-compatible adapter (rclone, s5cmd) gives data access outside an instance, and MK8s offers shared persistent storage across 1-Click Cluster nodes. missing for 10: an explicit statement that data survives instance termination, attach/mount and lifecycle details (e.g., API-driven attachment, capacity limits), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
